items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE (Remote Code Execution)
items.summary: BlockStrap is a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on Magento and Adobe Commerce installations. Adobe released APSB26-153 on October 13, 2026, to fix this, but a manual patch is required, and new installs remain vulnerable.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that enables unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Attacks exploiting this flaw began on September 4, 2026, leading Adobe to release an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146).

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization / Account Takeover in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Adobe addressed this in APSB26-92, and indications suggest active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Adobe patches critical Magento account takeover
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92 as isolated patch files, fixing seven vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. This update is crucial for protecting stores from various security risks.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released a security update resolving critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged authenticated attackers to bypass security measures and maintain unauthorized access. It impacts confidentiality and integrity of merchant data, customer records, and administrative resources.
